name: novelbits-logscope
description: Real-time embedded log viewer — Zephyr, nRF5 SDK, and raw mode with Bluetooth LE HCI decoding, filtering, search, fault detection, and Wireshark export

viewsWelcome.contents:
Connect a device to start viewing real-time logs.

[$(plug) Connect Device](command:logscope.connect)

[$(open-preview) Open Log Viewer](command:logscope.open)

[$(book) Get Started Guide](command:logscope.openWalkthrough)

Supports J-Link RTT and Serial UART transports.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with LogScope
walkthroughs.description: Connect to your embedded device and start viewing real-time logs in 3 steps.

steps.title: Connect Your Device
steps.description:
LogScope supports **J-Link RTT** (debug probe) and **Serial UART** (USB serial).

Click below to pick your transport, select a device, and connect.

[Connect Device](command:logscope.connect)

media.altText: Transport selection showing J-Link RTT and Serial UART options

steps.title: View Real-Time Logs
steps.description:
Once connected, the log viewer opens automatically.

Use the **filter bar** to toggle severity levels (ERR, WRN, INF, DBG), filter by module, or search.

**Parser modes:** Change Settings → Parser to switch between Zephyr, nRF5 SDK, or Raw mode.

**HCI decoding** shows Bluetooth LE packets with expandable details when using J-Link RTT.

[Open Log Viewer](command:logscope.open)

media.altText: Log viewer showing color-coded Zephyr logs and HCI packets

steps.title: Export & Analyze
steps.description:
Export your captured logs in three formats:

- **Text** (.log) — human-readable
- **JSON Lines** (.jsonl) — structured data
- **btsnoop** (.btsnoop) — HCI packets for Wireshark

[Export Logs](command:logscope.export)

media.altText: Export format options: Text, JSON Lines, and Wireshark btsnoop

enumDescriptions: J-Link RTT via pylink (recommended — works with any J-Link device)
Serial UART (CDC ACM or USB-to-UART bridge)
logscope.transport.description: Transport mode for reading log data.

logscope.rtt.pollInterval.description: RTT poll interval in milliseconds (nrfutil transport only). Lower = faster updates but more SWD traffic.

logscope.nrfutil.path.description: Path to nrfutil binary. Leave as 'nrfutil' if it's on your PATH.

logscope.rtt.silenceThreshold.description: Seconds of RTT silence before LogScope attempts a host-side RTT restart. Quiet devices (BLE peripherals waiting for connections, sensors logging once a minute) commonly go 30s+ without logs, so the default is generous. Set to 0 to disable silence-based recovery entirely. Real RTT errors (read failures, dropped probe) are still recovered separately.

logscope.rtt.legacyMode.description: Use the legacy libjlinkarm RTT API (pre-v0.6.0 code path) instead of the direct-memory RTT implementation. Enable only if you hit a regression in v0.6.0; please file an issue at https://github.com/NovelBits/logscope/issues with a reproduction.

logscope.uart.baudRate.description: Serial baud rate for UART transport.

logscope.uart.lastPort.description: Last used serial port path (used for auto-connect). Set automatically.

logscope.uart.dataBits.description: Number of data bits per UART frame. Most modern firmware uses 8.

logscope.uart.stopBits.description: Number of stop bits per UART frame. Most modern firmware uses 1.

logscope.uart.parity.description: Parity for the UART frame. 'none' is the most common; 'even' or 'odd' are sometimes used in legacy/industrial protocols.

logscope.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of log entries to keep in memory

logscope.autoConnect.description: Automatically connect to the last-used device when LogScope opens.

logscope.lastDevice.description: Last connected device (used for auto-connect). Set automatically.

logscope.columnWidths.description: Persisted log-viewer column widths in pixels (keys: time, ts, sev, mod). Set automatically when columns are resized.

logscope.logWrap.description: Wrap long log messages instead of truncating. Toggle via the wrap button in the viewer.

logscope.timeFormat.description: Time format for the wall-clock Time column.

logscope.jlink.path.description: Path to JLinkExe. Leave empty to auto-detect.

logscope.jlink.device.description: Default target device name for J-Link connection. Overridden by per-probe settings in jlink.deviceOverrides.

logscope.jlink.deviceOverrides.description: Per-probe J-Link device overrides. Maps probe serial number to target device name (e.g., {"777195662": "STM32F401RE"}). Set automatically via Change Settings.

logscope.jlink.remoteHost.description: Host or IP of a remote J-Link server (J-Link Remote Server) to connect to instead of a locally-attached probe. Leave empty for local probes. Experimental; full UI for remote-RTT is in progress.

logscope.jlink.rttSearchRanges.description: RTT control block search range (base size in hex). Default covers 512KB starting at 0x20000000 which works for most ARM Cortex-M devices.

enumDescriptions: Zephyr RTOS log format ([HH:MM:SS.mmm,uuu] <level> module: message)
nRF5 SDK NRF_LOG format (<severity> module: message)
Raw mode — display lines as-is with no parsing
logscope.parser.description: Log format parser. Select the format that matches your firmware's logging output.

logscope.watchPatterns.description: Watch patterns to match against incoming log lines. Each pattern shows an inline marker and a live hit counter in the sidebar.

name.description: Display name for this pattern (shown in sidebar and marker tooltip)

pattern.description: Text to match (substring by default, or regex if 'regex' is true)

regex.description: Treat pattern as a regular expression

module.description: Only match log entries from this module (case-insensitive). Omit to match all modules.

color.description: Hex color for the inline marker (e.g., '#ff9800'). Auto-assigned if omitted.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: LogScope restricts executable path settings in untrusted workspaces.
